       i.description            AS "materialDescription",
       l.lot_id                 AS "lotId",
       lot.lot_code             AS "lotCode",
       l.expiry_date            AS "expiryDate",
       t.code                   AS "inventoryTypeCode",
       u.code                   AS "uomCode",
       l.quantity               AS "quantity",
       l.picked_quantity        AS "pickedQuantity",
       l.pending_quantity       AS "pendingQuantity",
       l.short_quantity         AS "shortQuantity",
       l.short_reason           AS "shortReason",
       l.picked_at              AS "pickedAt",
       l.destination_location_id AS "destinationLocationId",
       dst.code                 AS "destinationLocationCode",
       l.pick_container_id      AS "pickContainerId",
       cnt.code                 AS "pickContainerCode",
       l.status                 AS "status"
  FROM out_pick_task_line l
  JOIN out_order       o   ON o.id   = l.outbound_order_id
  JOIN out_order_line  ol  ON ol.id  = l.outbound_order_line_id
  JOIN wh_location     loc ON loc.id = l.source_location_id
  JOIN md_item         i   ON i.id   = l.material_id
  JOIN inv_type        t   ON t.id   = l.inventory_type_id
  JOIN md_uom          u   ON u.id   = l.base_uom_id
  LEFT JOIN wh_zone    z   ON z.id   = l.zone_id
  LEFT JOIN lu_unit    lu  ON lu.id  = l.source_logistic_unit_id
  LEFT JOIN inv_lot    lot ON lot.id = l.lot_id
  LEFT JOIN wh_location dst ON dst.id = l.destination_location_id
  LEFT JOIN lu_unit    cnt ON cnt.id = l.pick_container_id
 WHERE l.tenant_id = ?
   AND l.task_id IN (?)
 ORDER BY l.task_id, l.sequence

       l.allocation_id          AS "allocationId",
       l.position_id            AS "positionId",

       l.status                 AS "status"
  FROM out_pick_task_line l

  JOIN wh_location     loc ON loc.id = l.source_location_id

  JOIN md_uom          u   ON u.id   = l.base_uom_id
  LEFT JOIN wh_zone    z   ON z.id   = l.zone_id
  LEFT JOIN lu_unit    lu  ON lu.id  = l.source_logistic_unit_id
  LEFT JOIN inv_lot    lot ON lot.id = l.lot_id
  LEFT JOIN wh_location dst ON dst.id = l.destination_location_id
  LEFT JOIN lu_unit    cnt ON cnt.id = l.pick_container_id
 WHERE l.tenant_id = ?
   AND l.task_id IN (?)
 ORDER BY l.task_id, l.sequence
